records.title: Host-agent SIGKILL preserves the lease and reconciles before reuse
records.blocker: There is no production host-agent identity, durable recovery loop or clean-state provider proving an agent crash cannot free or duplicate a live lease.

records.title: Temporary ownership-store failure never permits an unleased attach
records.blocker: The product controller is not wired to a fail-closed ownership authority with store-partition fault injection at reserve, attach, commit and release boundaries.

records.title: Source-host loss leaves the VM stopped and never triggers takeover
records.blocker: Host-failure HA is outside the product boundary, but no executable scheduler and ownership negative gate proves that source-host loss keeps the VM stopped and forbids cross-host reassignment.

records.title: Stale logical ownership epoch cannot commit, release or reassign
records.blocker: The multi-host authority does not yet issue monotonic logical epochs or reject every stale-agent commit, release and reassignment path without relying on BMC fencing.

records.title: Clean cold relocation requires both hosts online and source release before target reserve
records.blocker: The product has no two-online-host protocol that stops the VM, proves source cleanup and release, advances the logical epoch, then performs a fresh target solve and reserve.

records.title: Cold-relocation target exhaustion keeps the VM stopped with a stable reason
records.blocker: The planned relocation workflow does not yet prove target capacity exhaustion leaves the VM stopped, creates no target lease and reports a complete deterministic reason.

records.title: Live migration request is rejected for the baseline DirectPath profile
records.blocker: Live migration is outside the baseline boundary, but no product API, scheduler, launcher and backend negative gate proves rejection without assignment mutation.

records.title: VFIO migration backend is disabled for Qman DirectPath
records.blocker: The product has not implemented an executable negative gate proving VFIO migration capability, dirty tracking and state transfer remain disabled across API, scheduler, launcher and raw QEMU paths.
